headline.claim: 00a41030 and 00a40d60 are std::vector<int> push_back and insert, not grant entry points; the grant entry is 00a410a0 and the queue it appends to is drained into XUserWriteAchievements by 00a3fa70.
evidence: 00a41030 body: _Myfirst +4h, _Mylast +8h, _Myend +0Ch; stores *value at _Mylast and advances it when size < capacity, else calls 00a40d60 with a checked end iterator. __thiscall(this, const int*), RET 4.

00a40d60 returns a checked iterator {_Mycont=this, _Ptr=_Myfirst+offset} through an sret pointer and ends in RET 0x10 at 00a40de6; it calls 00a40b90 (_Insert_n) which can throw through 00a40ad0 (_Xlen).
00a410d3 ADD ECX,0x360 before CALL 0x00a41030: the vector is at manager+360h.
00a3fa70 reads +364h/+368h, builds an 8-byte-per-entry array at +3A0h, and is the only caller of XUserWriteAchievements 00a4d596 in the image.
00a40d60 has a second caller 00bb7c50, so the instantiation is shared and not award specific.

uncertainties: The vector at registry +0h..+0Fh is cleared by the constructor and never read on this path; its element type is unknown.
The Params (+30h) and Index (+34h) container offsets are inferred from the 00442190 and 004857f0 call shapes only.
0090c5d0's ECX is loaded but unread; whether it is a member of the object at game+21A0h or a free function reached with a stale register was not settled.
00a3e6a0 resets +11Ch to 1 rather than 0; session_polls.hpp already records kNoLocalSlot = 1 for the same manager, which is probably the same convention.
Four sign-in slots is an inference from the console's pad count; +8Ch is indexed without a bound check and no bound appears in the code.
The id table was read from one retail install; the patch level was not checked.

follow_up_packets.contract: The XUSER_ACHIEVEMENT array at manager+3A0h, the XOVERLAPPED at +384h, the ERROR_IO_PENDING state machine across +3A4h/+3A8h, the erase-on-completion loop, and who pumps it each frame with what force flag.
The whole Achievements.lua row schema including Params and Index, the vector at registry +0h, and the Lua table-walk helpers 00b65f50/00b660a0/00b66420 shared with every other data table loader.
The per-name counter 005070c0 returns, the RANK and Counter prefix rejections, and how a mission event reaches this routine.
The eight states at manager+3B0h, the XShowSigninUI and XShowMessageBoxUI prompts, and which state sets +119h, +11Ah and +11Ch.
